_doc: B2 concept materials, recovered VERBATIM from Macar et al.'s released code. The fidelity arm replicates their paradigm, so their words are replication materiel and are not paraphrased, reordered or substituted.

provenance.concepts_source: experiments/01_concept_injection.py:58 (DEFAULT_TEST_CONCEPTS, comment: '50 words from the paper')

extraction_method.rule: concept_vector = act(concept prompt) - mean(act over baseline prompts), at the declared layer, last token
extraction_method.DEVIATION_rule_13: their formatter applies a chat template when the tokenizer has one and falls back to 'User: {msg}\n\nAssistant:' otherwise. Rule 13 forbids chat templates at any stage or site, so we take THEIR OWN fallback, which is also the COMPLETION_TEMPLATE the detection harness already uses. Sanctioned by their design, not invented.
extraction_method.layer: per stage, that stage's A4-selected layer (rule 1); their DEFAULT_LAYER_FRACTION 0.7 is NOT inherited

selection_for_B2.status: AWAITING DESIGN-INSTANCE APPROVAL -- REQUIRED BEFORE ANY B2 SESSION
selection_for_B2.problem: PROPOSAL-g §4-B2 and LOCK-g §3 both register EIGHT concepts and describe them as Macar's. Macar's canonical set is FIFTY. There is no canonical eight to recover, so choosing which eight is a DECISION and not a recovery.
selection_for_B2.code_recommendation: the first eight in their declared order -- deterministic, recoverable from the source by anyone, and involving no cherry-picking
alternatives_not_taken: a seeded random draw from the 50 (declared seed; defensible but reproducible only via our config, not from their source)
a semantic spread chosen by hand (introduces our judgment into replication materiel, which the fidelity arm exists to avoid)
raise n to 50 (changes a registered n; a lock amendment, not a config choice)

ninth_concept.name: evaluative_axis
ninth_concept.note: PROPOSAL-g §4-B2: our own reward-marker as a ninth concept -- the affect-shaped probe. Not from Macar.

hygiene_rule_18.note: word-boundary matches, both directions. Collisions are REPORTED not silently dropped: a concept that also appears in an extraction or test pool is a design-instance call, since removing it would depart from the verbatim replication set.
